releases.title: JavaScript Playground 1.1.0
releases.summary: Cloud game saves let signed-in players pause an unfinished game and continue it later from another device.
highlights: Save, load, rename, replace, and delete up to five private save slots in every modern game.
Recognize saves at a glance with game-state screenshots, titles, elapsed time, score or progress, and the local save date.
Use Quick Save & Exit when leaving unfinished local play, then continue the same slot without choosing it again.
fixes: Prevents stale save data from silently replacing a newer version created on another device.
technical: Adds authenticated, revision-aware SQLite game saves with bounded versioned state and private screenshot storage.
Keeps online rooms authoritative and separate from client-authored solo and local save adapters.

releases.title: JavaScript Playground 1.0.1
releases.summary: A focused layout update keeps modern games playable and adjustable in iPad and other constrained browser viewports.
highlights: Modern games now fit their boards and primary controls more reliably within tablet browser viewports.
fixes: Restored normal page scrolling in iPad browsers so players can reach content below the game area.
Reduced unused top spacing and compacted modern game layouts, including Tetris controls in phone landscape, so gameplay stays visible without scrolling when space permits.
Restored the Battle Tanks full-screen action in compact tablet and short-viewport controls.
technical: Applied shared short-viewport and tablet layout rules consistently across the modern arcade.

releases.title: JavaScript Playground 1.0
releases.summary: The modern arcade brings six games together with shared profiles, themes, achievements, responsive play, and secure online rooms.
highlights: Play modern versions of Pong, Sudoku, Minesweeper, Tic-tac-toe, Battle Tanks, and Tetris from one arcade.
Keep scores, history, achievements, appearance, and audio preferences together across games.
Install the arcade as an app and play with layouts designed for phones, tablets, and desktops.
Create private or public online rooms for Pong, Tic-tac-toe, and Battle Tanks.
fixes: Improved full-screen controls and responsive layouts across the modern games.
Strengthened reconnect behavior, server-authoritative results, and multiplayer safety limits.
Improved keyboard, touch, focus, and screen-reader support throughout the shared arcade interface.
technical: Ships as a build-free browser application and one unprivileged Node.js container.
Includes immutable build dependencies, multi-platform images, an SBOM, provenance, and continuous vulnerability scanning.
Uses transactional SQLite migrations and server-derived scoring for authenticated results.
